title: PermDock claims in a Supabase access token
description: The claims the permdock supabase hook writes and the SQL helpers and subjectFromSupabase read, plus the OAuth claims subjectFromSupabase maps to the actor and delegation. Other claims pass through. Each hook claim may also sit under app_metadata. supabaseClaims() in permdock/supabase validates the same shape; tenant_id is the default rls.tenantClaim.

client_id.description: The OAuth client of a third-party app; becomes actor.id when there is no act claim.

scope.description: OAuth scopes, space-separated or as a list; becomes delegation.scopes.

user_role.description: Global roles: one name, a list, or null for none.

memberships_truncated.description: true when the size budget cut memberships or attrs.

tenant_id.description: The active tenant (the default rls.tenantClaim): the canonical text of one instance of the first scope.

attrs.description: Allow-listed server-owned attributes, read as principal.claims.attrs.<key>.

act.description: RFC 8693 actor chain; the innermost sub is the acting party.

id.description: Canonical text of the scope instance id (uuid::text for a uuid column); compared exactly, never lower-cased.

within.description: The id of every ancestor scope instance, by scope name.

grants.description: Custom roles in compact form, read by the helpers in jwt mode.
